icons.name: api-key
icons.heading: API key
icons.description: Authorize an app: the key goes in, turns, and the code opens. Light: the key pushes in 2 units and stops with a hit, then turns on its shaft (its profile closes up toward the shaft line, as a key seen side-on does when it turns); a beat later the code brackets spring apart and settle, and the key turns back and withdraws. Strong: the key draws back first, drives in 2.5 with a hit and a rebound, turns further, and the brackets spring wider with a bounce. The brackets never leave their rows; the key stays rigid.

icons.name: endpoint
icons.heading: Endpoint
icons.description: Connect a configured endpoint. Light: the plug drives 5 units into the socket and seats with a hit and a small rebound; the socket takes the shock and its live light flicks on inside it, then fades. Strong: the plug draws back first, rams home with a hit, a rebound and a second hit; the socket is knocked twice and the light blinks twice (a handshake). The plug stays seated (connected). The reverse pulls the plug back out, tugging the socket as it releases; no light.

icons.name: rate-limit
icons.heading: Rate limit
icons.description: Requests are throttled. Light: the first packet rushes the closed gate, hits it and is knocked back to the queue; the packet behind follows and is held short of the gate; the gate shudders on its foot from the impact and settles. Strong: both packets wind up and rush the gate in turn, each hits and is thrown back past its place before settling, and the gate shudders twice. The foot never moves; the gate stays rigid and only rocks on its base.

icons.heading: Request timeout

Strong: the hand winds back first, laps and knocks at the top with a rebound, the timer rattles like an alarm, and the stop shudders harder. The hand ends a whole turn from where it started; an invisible step returns it to 0 so the end matches the rest pixel for pixel.

icons.name: model-card
icons.heading: Model card
icons.description: Inspect a model specification. Light: the model emblem on the card turns a quarter (a gem turned to show its other face) and lands with a click, and the specification lines are written out beneath it in order. Strong: the emblem winds back, turns a half with a pop, knocks and settles, and the lines write out with a longer stagger. The card never moves. A 90 or 180 degree turn of the four-fold emblem ends on its own outline; an invisible step returns the angle to 0 so the end matches the rest pixel for pixel.

Strong: the shackle is pressed shut first, springs open past its stop and settles with a bounce, and the columns hop higher with a small second bounce. The shackle stays open (accessible). icons.heading: Model picker
icons.description: Choose the second model. Strong: each arrow gathers before it shoots, travels further and knocks with a rebound, and the nodes squeeze harder. Endpoints never leave their places.

icons.name: max-tokens
icons.heading: Max tokens
icons.description: Set a hard output length. Light: the end bracket slams 5 units in toward the output and stops dead at the new limit with a small rebound; the output rows flinch back from it in turn (longest row first) and settle. Strong: the bracket is pulled back first, slams in, rebounds and hits again; the rows flinch harder and twice. The bracket never passes the new limit (no overshoot on the value) and stays there. The reverse: the bracket is pressed in to release, then swings back out to the large limit and lands; the rows breathe out after it.
